auth_lifecycle.unauthenticated_behavior: Redirect to login and preserve intended route.
auth_lifecycle.forbidden_behavior: Render an accessible 403 state without retry loops.
auth_lifecycle.logout_behavior: Revoke server refresh token and clear client auth state.

routing.strategy: React Router with nested protected layouts

state_management.server_state_strategy: TanStack Query owns API server state.
state_management.ui_state_strategy: Component/local context only for ephemeral UI state.
state_management.cache_strategy: Query-key cache with explicit stale times.
invalidation_rules: Invalidate dashboard summary after successful mutations.
Invalidate entity detail/list keys after writes.

forms_validation.api_validation_mapping: Map 422 field errors to fields and preserve global detail.
forms_validation.rate_limit_mapping: Map 429 to retry guidance without automatic storms.

idempotency.key_generation: Generate one UUID per user intent and reuse only for the same payload retry.
idempotency.replay_handling: Treat documented replay response as success and do not duplicate optimistic effects.
idempotency.conflict_handling: Surface changed-payload reuse as a blocking conflict.

observability.client_error_strategy: Attach request ID and route context to sanitized client error reports.
observability.pii_policy: Do not place secrets or sensitive payloads in telemetry.

accessibility.keyboard_or_switch_navigation: All interactive flows operable by keyboard.
accessibility.screen_reader_or_talkback: Semantic labels and live regions for async feedback.
accessibility.focus_management: Move focus to validation/error summaries and restored dialogs intentionally.

component_or_ui.strategy: Component tests for permissions, forms and states.

integration.strategy: API client/auth refresh/error mapping integration tests.

e2e.strategy: Critical approved-slice journeys against a real test API.

offline.storage_strategy: No durable business writes offline; preserve safe UI draft state only.
offline.sync_conflict_policy: Refetch canonical server state before retrying mutations.

brownfield.cutover_trigger: Release gate approval for the replacement slice.
